capabilities: insert variables and function results into notes
execute JavaScript code that manipulates template variables and functions
share templates as gist files in a showcase
extras: README carries a security warning that the plugin can execute arbitrary JavaScript and system commands, so only trusted template code should be run; full documentation is hosted externally rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Templates only insert static text with limited placeholders, with no support for logic, dynamic values, or scripted manipulation.
summary: Template engine that inserts dynamic variables, function results, and user-written JavaScript into notes when they are created or edited.
